versions.title: Espíritos dos Dados
versions.subtitle: Colecione · Choque · Explore
versions.prompt: Create one transparent production game logo localized in pt-BR. Match the attached image's established brand: expressive chunky custom golden yellow lettering, warm orange bevels, thick extruded royal blue outline and navy shadow, cream keyline, bright small highlights. Replace all lettering with EXACT title "Espíritos dos Dados", on one or two balanced lines, and EXACT subtitle "Colecione · Choque · Explore" in clearly legible white letters on a compact curved blue ribbon below with small gold star ends. Preserve every accent mark including Vietnamese diacritics. No English/Chinese words left. No creatures, no background, no additional words. Wide compact logo about 2.6:1 with 5 percent transparent padding. All lettering in frame, readable at 350 pixels wide on a phone. This is a friendly original pet collecting dice adventure. True transparent alpha.
